key_idea: With length at most 80, test every proper substring: it must contain all distinct characters while dropping its first or its last character loses one; collect them in a set for uniqueness.
sketch: Compute the distinct character count of the whole string. For every (l,r) other than the full string, check that s[l..r] has all characters but s[l+1..r] and s[l..r-1] do not, and insert the substring into a set. Output the set size. About 80^2 substrings times O(80) per check, per test. Pitfalls: the whole string is excluded (so a string of all distinct characters gives 0, and 'bb' gives 1), and uniqueness is by content, not position.
